rule: GOAL: Fill four empty slots to match the color sequence shown in the top reference row. CONTROLS: Click a color in the bottom palette to select it, then click a slot to place it. RULE: Each color from the palette is consumed when used, so every color must be placed exactly once. TRAP: Believing the palette order dictates the solution; the top row is the only true target sequence.

GOAL: Align the key with the target slot by manipulating the boundary wall. CONTROLS: Click blue blocks to shift the gray wall's edge left or right. RULE: The key is glued to the wall's edge and moves automatically with it. TRAP: Do not try to move the key directly; it only follows the wall's position.

GOAL: Move the key right by expanding the middle wall's space. CONTROLS: Top buttons widen the middle gap; bottom buttons shift the bottom wall. RULE: Each click shifts walls by four units; coordinate positions matter more than visual gaps. TRAP: Assuming the middle wall expands indefinitely; it blocks when hitting the top wall's edge.

GOAL: Route falling paint into the right-side cup. CONTROLS: Arrows moved the bar; Space dropped the paint. RULE: Position the bar so the drop column aligns with its right edge. TRAP: Believing any bar placement catching the drop would work, ignoring spill direction.

GOAL: Guide the floating yellow block down into the waiting socket at the bottom. CONTROLS: Click switches to set bar and stem colors; click the ball to run the program. RULE: Matching colors trigger a downward move, stacking the block neatly into the target slot. TRAP: Assuming complex color patterns were needed; uniform settings simplified the path immediately.

GOAL: Move the square to touch the green ball. CONTROLS: Clicking inside the ring teleports the square. RULE: The click must land within a strict radius of the square's center, not just the visual ring. TRAP: Assuming any click inside the drawn circle works; clicks too far from the center fail silently.

GOAL: Place two heavy blocks into their matching floor slots. CONTROLS: Arrow keys move the player; Space attaches or releases the carried block. RULE: You must stand directly below a block and press Up to lift it, then walk it to the target. TRAP: Trying to push blocks horizontally fails; you must lift and carry them, ensuring you drop them precisely onto the marked zones.

GOAL: Reach the target tile by sliding across the board. CONTROLS: Arrow keys slide the character in that direction. RULE: You stop only when hitting a wall or a tile of a different color. TRAP: Believing you can stop anywhere; you must plan to land exactly on the goal.

GOAL: Shift cursor columns to align five glyph pools with target shapes. CONTROLS: Arrows move cursor; pressing aligns current column. RULE: Each column requires specific vertical shifts to match reference keys. TRAP: Assuming uniform shift direction for all columns wastes actions.

GOAL: Align three colored keys with their sockets by adjusting bar heights. CONTROLS: Click bars to raise or lower them, changing the key’s vertical position. RULE: The level ends only when all three keys share the exact row of their matching socket. TRAP: Confusing the fixed socket markers with the movable keys led to checking the wrong positions, causing unnecessary adjustments.

GOAL: Arrange seven lettered blocks into a single specific sequence to complete the puzzle. CONTROLS: Click a placed block to select it, then click another to swap their positions; press space to submit the final arrangement. RULE: Only the exact left-to-right order of letters matters, regardless of which physical slot each letter occupies. TRAP: Assuming you must move blocks one by one into an empty slot, wasting time when direct swaps are instant.

GOAL: Place seven colored blocks into their matching outline slots. CONTROLS: Click a palette block, then click its target outline. Press Space to confirm. RULE: Match each color to the outline of the same hue, regardless of shape or position. TRAP: Assuming outlines indicate specific block shapes; they only signal color targets, not geometry.

ESTABLISHED: Grabbing blocks in panel order keeps them aligned with the head. The tip-held block follows vertical moves, but detached blocks do not. FAILED: Moving the head up after grabbing all three blocks broke alignment because detached blocks stayed put. GOAL IS NOT: Simply attaching all blocks to the tip regardless of vertical position. CONTROLS: Panel keys grab specific colors. Direction keys move the head; only tip-attached blocks follow vertical movement.

GOAL: Reach the exit by defeating the lungeing enemy. CONTROLS: Arrow keys slide the player two cells. RULE: The enemy kills you if you slide to land adjacent to it. TRAP: Trying to jump over or land on the enemy fails; you must hit it directly.

ESTABLISHED: The grid resets to green after a successful match. The key’s rotation does not change during the match or immediately after the grid clears. FAILED: Turning the key before or after the match does not trigger a win. Matching the diamond pattern alone is insufficient. GOAL IS NOT: Simply matching the diamond pattern or rotating the key to any specific orientation independently. CONTROLS: Clicking cells toggles their color. Arrow keys rotate the key 90 degrees.

GOAL: Grow two small blocks into one large shape to fill the target zone. CONTROLS: Click near a block to move it; click between two blocks to merge them. RULE: Merging doubles a block's size, making it easier to reach distant goals in fewer steps. TRAP: Do not merge too early; small blocks have short reach, so move them close together before combining.

GOAL: Match each slot's shape to the key's target. CONTROLS: Arrow keys cycled shapes in specific slots. RULE: Rotation did not matter; only the shape identity counted. TRAP: Assuming each slot required a specific upright pose wasted time.

GOAL: Arrange the colored tokens to match the hollow outline sequence, ensuring the special port aligns correctly with the green box's internal slot structure. CONTROLS: Click a token in the palette to select it, then click the target slot on the grid to place it. Press Space to confirm the solution. RULE: The port must occupy the third position in the sequence, sitting inside the green box rather than on the outer track. TRAP: Assuming the port fills a standard outer slot caused confusion; it must nest within the green container to satisfy the pattern.

GOAL: Move the diamond tip through the blade and into the handle to complete the key. CONTROLS: Arrow keys shift the tip horizontally or vertically within the blade's bounds. RULE: The tip must travel along the top row, bypassing the blocked lower notch. TRAP: Clicking the target cell first does nothing; you must push the tip there physically.

GOAL: Decode letter segments into a hidden seven-letter word, then match the answer row to that target sequence. CONTROLS: Arrows move the cursor; pressing UP or DOWN cycles the shape in the current blue slot. RULE: Each letter’s segment length determines its position in the word, forcing a unique segmentation of the key. TRAP: Assuming every slot cycles through all seven shapes; some slots only cycle through a subset, wasting actions.

GOAL: Build a Y-shape from materials and deliver it to the second ball. CONTROLS: Click near two items to merge them; click a spot to move an item closer. RULE: Merging only works if two items are within a specific short distance of each other. TRAP: Believing the first ball absorbs the shape to finish; you must deliver the final shape to the target ball.

GOAL: Align your cross's arms to cover all four dots of your color. CONTROLS: Arrow keys move the cross; space confirms placement. RULE: The cross must be centered exactly where the horizontal and vertical dot lines intersect. TRAP: You cannot stop the cross early to save moves; you must move the full distance to the intersection point.

GOAL: Guide the player to the exit while avoiding enemies. CONTROLS: Arrow keys move the player one space in that direction. RULE: Enemies instantly slide toward the player if aligned in the same row or column. TRAP: Assuming enemies only move on their turn; they react immediately to your positioning, not just after you stop.

GOAL: Slide the three colored blocks to the left wall. CONTROLS: Arrows move the grabber tip; it pushes or pulls blocks in chains. RULE: Blocks stack tightly against walls or each other; the tip can pass over detached blocks. TRAP: Continuing to pull left when blocks hit the wall causes the tip to lose grip and detach.

GOAL: Place the purple bead at the ring's center. CONTROLS: Click a diamond to move it to that spot, swapping with any diamond already there. RULE: The bead sits exactly halfway between the white and gray diamonds. TRAP: Thinking you must move the bead directly; you only control the diamonds.

GOAL: Move each shape to cover its matching colored dots. CONTROLS: Arrow keys move the highlighted shape; spacebar switches to the next shape. RULE: A shape collects a dot only when its center aligns perfectly with the dot's location. TRAP: Assuming all shapes move simultaneously; you must manually cycle through each shape to position it correctly.

GOAL: Extend the green and yellow bars until they physically touch the distant diamond shapes. CONTROLS: Click the right glyph to lengthen the green bar horizontally; click the down glyph to lengthen the yellow bar vertically. RULE: Each click extends the bar by exactly three units, regardless of current length. TRAP: Believing the bar had a fixed maximum size; it actually grows indefinitely until it collides with the diamond.

GOAL: Slide plus pieces into their target slots to clear the level. CONTROLS: Click a plus to select it, then click its destination to move it. RULE: A selected piece shows a ghost preview at its next valid empty spot. TRAP: Clicking a different piece while one is selected cancels the selection instead of switching to the new piece.

GOAL: Rotate the ring so the yellow block aligns with the yellow bracket at the top-left. CONTROLS: Clicking the red arrow rotates the ring one step counter-clockwise; clicking the green arrow rotates it clockwise. RULE: Only clicking the arrows moves the ring; clicking on the blocks themselves does nothing. TRAP: I wasted time clicking specific blocks, incorrectly assuming they would rotate the ring to bring them to the target position.

GOAL: Cover all eight dots using the line, X, and diamond shapes. CONTROLS: Arrows move the active white cursor; Space cycles through the three shapes. RULE: Move each shape to cover its assigned dots, ensuring the cursor stays in bounds. TRAP: Thinking shapes must stay fixed; they move freely, but the cursor’s path determines if a move is possible.

GOAL: Match panel D’s cell colors to the white blocks shown in its small glyph icon. CONTROLS: Clicking a grid cell toggles its color between blue and red. RULE: The glyph acts as a static target map where white blocks indicate cells that must be red. TRAP: Assuming the glyph updates live to show your current progress; it remains fixed, showing only the final goal.

GOAL: Match the panel’s hidden pattern to the two overlapping glyph projections. CONTROLS: Click grid cells to toggle their color between blue and red. RULE: White cells in the glyphs indicate red targets; overlapping cells must agree on color. TRAP: Assuming the cursor’s center cell needs painting; it is covered and irrelevant to the pattern.

GOAL: Move a plus to collect orange dots, then recolor it to match and collect the remaining dots. CONTROLS: Arrows move the cursor; Spacebar changes its shape from plus to cross. RULE: Touching a dot with the matching color removes it permanently; the bar drains slowly, so you have time. TRAP: Assuming dots vanish only when uncovered; they are actually deleted immediately, so don't waste moves checking.

GOAL: Move the block to the hole in the right room. CONTROLS: Arrows push blocks; clicks switch your control to any block. RULE: Clicking a block lets you move it directly, bypassing push mechanics. TRAP: Assuming you must push blocks from behind wastes time; switch control instead.

GOAL: Position two Y blocks into the two fixed brackets on the outer ring. CONTROLS: Rotating the outer ring shifts all blocks; rotating the inner lines swaps blocks between the ring and the line. RULE: Outer rotations move Y blocks predictably, while line rotations allow you to park one Y block to adjust the other. TRAP: Thinking you must move both Y blocks simultaneously; you must isolate them by parking one in a line while positioning the other.

ESTROLISHED: The piece covers the plus marker without clearing. The floor shape does not match the plaque glyph. The step budget bar drains toward game over, not victory. FAILED: Placing the piece on the plus. Matching the room shape to the glyph. Assuming rotation changes the piece’s cap orientation. GOAL IS NOT: Simply covering the plus with the block. CONTROLS: Movement shifts the piece on a grid. Rotation cycles the piece’s state but does not visibly alter its cap position or color split.

GOAL: Paint 14 specific cells orange to reveal a hidden shape. CONTROLS: Tapping a glyph toggles its dot color, changing how it paints blocks. RULE: White blocks take the dot's color; gray blocks take the opposite color. TRAP: Assuming gray blocks match the dot color directly, rather than inverting.

GOAL: Rotate two overlapping diamond rings to align matching blocks. CONTROLS: Four arrows shifted specific ring segments clockwise or counter-clockwise. RULE: The rings share only the top and bottom corner slots; side edges remain distinct. TRAP: Assuming the rings overlapped along a full vertical column, causing misaligned rotations.

ESTABLISHED: The level is a 10x10 double spiral maze with 55 walkable blocks. Two squares start at row 8, columns 2 and 6. FAILED: Clicking on a square or an empty walkable corner produced no visible change or teleportation. GOAL IS NOT: A simple point-to-point traversal to a single center, as the spiral structure implies a more complex winding path or dual objective. CONTROLS: Keyboard movement moves squares by one block. Mouse clicks on tiles or squares currently have no observed effect.

GOAL: Relocate the chain’s head to the target without crossing water or breaking the rope. CONTROLS: Click an endpoint to swap entry points; click a free tile to drag the head. RULE: The rope cannot pass through water tiles; it must stay on solid ground. TRAP: Assuming the rope stretches to reach distant points; it has a fixed length and snaps if pulled too far.

ESTABLISHED: The level is 7 wide. A 5x5 blue ring and a red block exist. The red block traces an L-shaped path through narrow 3-wide channels. FAILED: Moving the blue block into the red channels. Pressing SPACE without move history. Pushing the red blob. GOAL IS NOT: Simply placing the blue ring on the bottom-right socket while ignoring the red blob. CONTROLS: Arrow keys move blocks. SPACE switches modes or resets, altering HUD icons and a selector bar.

GOAL: Deliver the block to the plaque mouth while the corner glyph matches the plaque. CONTROLS: Arrows move the block; landing on the plus rotates the corner glyph. RULE: The plaque barrier only opens if the corner matches when the block arrives. TRAP: Assuming the match state persists or unlocks the plaque remotely; you must match, then travel without touching the plus again.

GOAL: Paint specific grid cells orange while ensuring the top-left corner is blue. CONTROLS: Clicking a cell cycles its color through blue, red, then orange. RULE: The target pattern required the first cell to be blue, not red or orange. TRAP: Assuming the first cell needed painting; leaving it blue saved two clicks and avoided overwriting the correct state.

GOAL: Swap the two black squares between their opposite starting pockets. CONTROLS: Arrow keys slide the selected square through open maze paths. RULE: The level ends only when each square occupies the other’s starting position. TRAP: Believing you must reach the exact final coordinates; stopping when the squares merely crossed paths wasted time.

GOAL: Slide the plug into the socket by aligning its prongs with the pins. CONTROLS: Arrow keys move the plug freely across the grid; no rotation or other actions were used. RULE: The plug’s red tips must touch the socket’s pins to complete the connection. TRAP: Believing the prongs needed to fully overlap the pins wasted time; simple adjacency is sufficient.

GOAL: Position the black piece so its mirror image aligns perfectly with the yellow target. CONTROLS: Arrow keys slide the piece until it hits a wall or obstacle, not one cell at a time. RULE: The gray reflection is a strict mirror of the black piece’s position across the central axis. TRAP: Assuming arrows move the piece one cell per press wastes moves; you must account for full slides.

GOAL: Guide the blue block from the top-left corner to the green goal at the bottom-right through the maze. CONTROLS: Arrow keys move the block one grid step in the chosen direction. RULE: Only gray corridors are passable; white spaces are walls, so you must follow the gray path. TRAP: Assuming you can slide across open spaces wastes time; each key press moves exactly one step.

GOAL: Clear the level by solving the puzzle within the shrinking step limit. CONTROLS: Click arrows to move the piston; click the handle to adjust the track. RULE: Each action reduces the top pink bar, acting as a strict step counter. TRAP: Believing the black track handle moves the main shape; it was a static decoy.

GOAL: Guide the green block to the yellow target while navigating around static obstacles. CONTROLS: Arrow keys move the selected block; clicking a block’s icon rotates it to change orientation. RULE: Blocks leave a gray trail that blocks future paths, but rotating a block over its own trail clears it. TRAP: Assuming trails are permanent; rotating a block back over its path resets those cells to free space.

GOAL: Align the reflected gray ghost exactly onto the yellow target zone. CONTROLS: Arrows move the selected piece or wall; Space switches selection between them. RULE: The gray ghost mirrors the black piece horizontally across the vertical wall's center line. TRAP: Moving the wall vertically changes nothing; only horizontal wall movement shifts the ghost's column position.

GOAL: Align the green piston head with the matching green notch in the chamber wall. CONTROLS: Click buttons to shift gray fluid between chambers, altering available space; click the piston to move it into open areas. RULE: The head only fits when the middle chamber’s gray boundary is fully cleared to zero. TRAP: Assuming the top bar’s buttons were irrelevant; they actually drained fluid to create necessary room.

GOAL: Slide three heavy blocks into a narrow floor slot to form a solid bar. CONTROLS: Arrows walk and push; Space grabs or drops a block held directly above you. RULE: You cannot push blocks sideways while facing them; you must stand behind and walk forward. TRAP: Do not try to carry blocks; they are too heavy to lift, only to shove.

GOAL: Drop the plug five blocks down into the socket. CONTROLS: Top bars set vertical direction; bottom bars set horizontal movement; clicking the plug executes the path. RULE: Matching top and bottom settings creates a straight downward move for each aligned block. TRAP: Believing the plug stops at the first block; it actually travels the full distance until hitting the socket.

GOAL: Move two black pieces to yellow targets so mirror ghosts match. CONTROLS: Arrows move selected piece; Space cycles selection. RULE: Pieces reflect across row 28; align pieces to top targets to satisfy bottom ghosts. TRAP: Assuming pieces stop at edges; they slide until hitting walls, requiring precise step counts to avoid overshooting targets.

GOAL: Clean the upper block with white, then stamp the lower section purple using the ring path. CONTROLS: Arrows move the stamp along the track; clicks select ink colors; space applies the stamp. RULE: The track is a fixed loop; plan the shortest route to avoid wasting moves. TRAP: Assuming the stamp stays in place after cleaning; it must be manually moved to the next target.

GOAL: Align four colored pistons to precise depths by balancing fluid in linked chambers. CONTROLS: Click a side to push the piston down, forcing fluid into the connected chamber and raising the other piston. RULE: The sum of fluid in connected chambers is constant; moving one piston inevitably moves its partner. TRAP: Assuming pistons move independently. Forgetting that pushing one side shrinks the other chamber’s space causes wasted clicks and impossible states.

ESTABLISHED: Destroying a brick triggers water to erode adjacent rock, opening horizontal paths. Bricks block this erosion. FAILED: Clicking empty rock does nothing; the simulation does not advance without removing a brick. GOAL IS NOT: Simply waiting for water to rise on its own or clicking random empty spaces. CONTROLS: Clicking a brick removes it, causing water to flood and erode nearby rock, potentially clearing a path for the boat.

GOAL: Align five pink glyphs to match the target sequence. CONTROLS: Arrows move the cursor; up and down cycle the selected glyph. RULE: Ignore glyph rotation; match shapes regardless of orientation. TRAP: Assuming rotation matters wastes time; shapes are invariant to spin.

GOAL: Paint the remaining bottom-left purple cells by routing the stamp through the station ring. CONTROLS: Arrows move the stamp between stations; Space paints the current row segment; Clicks select the color. RULE: The eight stations form a fixed loop where each arrow direction strictly moves you to the adjacent station in that sequence. TRAP: Assuming arrows move the stamp freely across the grid wastes time; you must hop station-to-station along the ring to reach painting spots.

GOAL: Shift the wall down, move the crown right, and position the bar to match the mirrored ghost outlines. CONTROLS: Arrow keys move the selected piece; Space cycles through the wall, crown, and bar. RULE: Pieces align to a central mirror line, so moving one piece changes the target position for its counterpart. TRAP: Assuming pieces block each other wastes time; they pass through one another, so sequence does not matter.

GOAL: Align seven slots to target symbols. CONTROLS: Arrows move cursor; Up/Down cycles symbols. RULE: Symbols follow a fixed order; choose shortest path. TRAP: Assuming uniform direction saves time; mixed Up/Down cuts moves.

GOAL: Decode an eight-glyph sentence into words that map to seven specific blue symbols. CONTROLS: Arrows move the cursor and cycle through available symbol options for each slot. RULE: Only word lengths matching the key pairs fit the yellow and blue slot counts exactly. TRAP: Assuming all key pairs are used once; repetition is required to fill the blue row.

GOAL: Guide the purple ball along the dotted path into the blue circle target. CONTROLS: Clicking a cell on the trajectory ahead of the ball moves it that distance. RULE: The ball only moves if you click a valid path cell within its reach. TRAP: Clicking the ball itself or cells off the defined path wastes actions with no effect.

GOAL: Align two walls and a piece to completely cover the yellow target area. CONTROLS: Arrows move the currently selected object; Space cycles selection between the horizontal wall, vertical wall, and piece. RULE: Only full coverage of the yellow zone counts; ghost cells extending onto the blue background are harmless. TRAP: Assuming strict exact-cover logic fails; allow the piece to extend beyond the yellow boundary if it ensures full coverage.

GOAL: Fill four slots to match the top color sequence. CONTROLS: Click a palette shape to select, then click a slot to place it. RULE: Selecting a shape swaps it with the gray dot in the target slot. TRAP: Thinking you can drag directly; you must click twice per item to swap positions.

GOAL: Reach the exit while avoiding the patrolling guard. CONTROLS: Arrow keys move one step; the guard lunges toward you. RULE: Stay out of the guard’s row until you are directly beneath it. TRAP: Assuming you can move into the guard’s cell safely from below.

GOAL: Rearrange yellow tiles to match the target pattern exactly. CONTROLS: Arrow keys cycle the selected tile through its available states. RULE: Each tile operates on an independent cycle, allowing precise positioning step-by-step. TRAP: Assuming the cycle length is uniform for all tiles; verifying each one prevents overshooting the target.

GOAL: Align a sliding bar to direct falling liquid into specific cup notches. CONTROLS: Arrow keys move the bar horizontally; space triggers the liquid pour. RULE: Liquid spreads evenly across the bar, then falls off both outer edges simultaneously. TRAP: Assuming liquid falls only directly beneath the pour point rather than from the bar's ends.

GOAL: Extend the green bar rightward until it touches the plus sign. CONTROLS: Clicks moved the internal dot; the bar grew behind it. RULE: The bar lengthens to fill the space between the start and the dot. TRAP: Thinking the plus blocks movement; it only registers contact when the bar reaches it.

GOAL: Send the plug to the top socket by setting the correct direction codes. CONTROLS: Click bars to toggle black or white states, then press the gray box to run the program. RULE: A black third bar forces movement north, overriding all other directional signals in that column. TRAP: Assuming colors combine additively like arrows; they do not, as the north signal completely masks east and west.

GOAL: Guide two colored crosses to their matching target zones using limited moves. CONTROLS: Arrow keys slide the active cross three spaces per press; Space switches focus between crosses. RULE: Every press moves exactly three grid units, so start and end positions must align to multiples of three. TRAP: Assuming one space per press wastes actions; always calculate distance in three-space chunks to avoid misalignment.

GOAL: Merge two three-by-three blocks into a single four-by-four block to reach the target zone. CONTROLS: Click the center of the destination square to move a selected block by a fixed step size. RULE: Blocks merge automatically when they are placed adjacent to one another with overlapping edges. TRAP: Do not assume you can merge blocks separated by a gap; they must touch directly to combine.

GOAL: Position two beads so their midpoint lands exactly on the ring. CONTROLS: Click a bead to move the active one; click the inactive bead to swap roles. RULE: The purple square marks the midpoint, so choose coordinates where the average hits the ring center. TRAP: Thinking you can move both beads simultaneously; you must swap to position the second one.

GOAL: Direct three liquid streams into three separate collection cups without spilling. CONTROLS: Click bars to activate them; arrow keys move bars horizontally; space pours the liquid. RULE: Only the active blue bar deflects the flow; inactive red bars allow liquid to pass through or block it harmlessly. TRAP: Assuming all positioned bars deflect simultaneously; only the single clicked blue bar controls the split, so others must be moved out of the way.

GOAL: Rearrange five items into their correct positions using only swaps. CONTROLS: Click a slot to select it, then click another slot to swap their contents. Press space to submit the solution. RULE: Selecting a filled slot swaps it with the target; empty slots act as neutral buffers that do not disrupt the cycle. TRAP: Believing you need a dedicated empty buffer slot for every move. Direct swaps between filled slots are faster and sufficient.

GOAL: Place colored items into three connected boxes to unlock the level. CONTROLS: Click palette colors to select, click empty slots to place items, and press space to finish. RULE: Items must follow the handle order: left red, green box, middle red, blue box, right red. TRAP: Ignoring handle sequence leads to misplacement; always map colors to specific slot zones before clicking.

GOAL: Move the plug block to cover the white plus symbol. CONTROLS: Arrows slide the block one grid step; Down moves vertically, Left moves horizontally. RULE: You must navigate the open corridors to reach the target zone, ensuring the block fully overlaps the plus. TRAP: Assuming the plus is a solid obstacle prevents you from realizing you must actually step on it to win.

GOAL: Fill the remaining slots to form a connected chain of letters and symbols. CONTROLS: Click a palette symbol, then click an empty slot to place it. Press space to submit. RULE: The hollow connector must sit in the red box to link the two sections. TRAP: Thinking the connector belongs in the green box because it is green; it actually fits the red box.

GOAL: Align four horizontal bars to direct three falling water streams into two cups, requiring precise positioning so the streams split and rise correctly. CONTROLS: Arrow keys move the selected blue bar; clicking another bar switches selection; the spacebar pours the water to test the path. RULE: Water splits at bar ends, creating two streams that rise upward through gaps to fill cup notches above. TRAP: Assuming eight left moves were needed for the second bar when only two were required, causing wasted actions and time.

GOAL: Align three shapes to specific targets using a cycling selection cursor. CONTROLS: Arrows move the selected shape; Space cycles to the next shape. RULE: Only the shape marked by the cursor responds to arrow keys. TRAP: Assuming all shapes could be moved simultaneously or that selection order was fixed.

ESTABLISHED: The tip oscillates between 2x2 and 4x4 sizes when interacting at the left-center position, regardless of identical inputs. The green bar steadily decreases with every action, acting as a strict timer. FAILED: Repeating the same interaction at the same spot toggles size rather than progressing. Assuming size changes indicate success. GOAL IS NOT: Simply maximizing tip size or triggering the shrink-grow cycle, as this loop does not clear the level. CONTROLS: Arrow keys move the tip. Clicking adds green cells. The bar drains per action, not per second.

GOAL: Align the yellow block with the highlighted corner slot. CONTROLS: Red clicks shift the block left along the top edge; green clicks shift it right. RULE: Moving the block along the loop path brings it to the target position. TRAP: Assuming the arrows rotate the entire board rather than moving a single block.

GOAL: Place three shapes to cover all dots. CONTROLS: Arrows move the selected shape. Space cycles the selection. RULE: Move shapes in cycle order to avoid wasted clicks. TRAP: Assuming any move order is efficient wastes time on extra selection presses.

ESTABLISHED: Red is at lane 0, column 0. Blue is at lane 1, column 0. The bar tip is at column 34. FAILED: Pushing blue upward when red occupies the destination lane caused a conflict or refusal. GOAL IS NOT: Simply moving blue to lane 0 column 0 while red is present there. CONTROLS: Pressing UP moves the bar and pushes blocks in its path; occupied destinations block the move.

GOAL: Move two blocks through a spiral maze to the top bar so they can meet. CONTROLS: Arrow keys moved both blocks simultaneously in the same direction. RULE: The arms were too narrow for the blocks to pass each other, forcing them to meet only in the wide top section. TRAP: Believing you could solve it by moving one block while leaving the other still; both must move together.

GOAL: Align all colored bars to match the target pattern. CONTROLS: Click plus or minus buttons to extend or shrink each colored bar. RULE: Extending one bar pushes all subsequent bars in that chain away from the start. TRAP: Assuming bars grow independently; they are linked, so moving one shifts the entire line behind it.

GOAL: Slide the shrunken key tip left into the lock. CONTROLS: Arrows move the tip; clicks rotate or toggle grid cells. RULE: The tip only slides when split vertically, moving two columns per press. TRAP: Believing the tip remains tall after shrinking; it becomes a two-row block, changing movement mechanics.

GOAL: Move shapes to specific color zones to change their hue. CONTROLS: Arrows move the selected piece; Space switches pieces. RULE: A piece adopts the color of the last zone it touches. TRAP: Passing through a zone temporarily changes color, but only the final position matters.

GOAL: Move two yellow blocks to target slots on the rotating rings. CONTROLS: Red and green arrows rotate specific rings clockwise or counter-clockwise. RULE: Only the yellow blocks' positions matter; other blocks are ignored obstacles. TRAP: Tracking every block's position is unnecessary; focus solely on the yellow pair.

GOAL: Reduce the board to a single remaining peg. CONTROLS: Click a peg to select it, then click the highlighted ghost cell to jump. RULE: Jumps work vertically and horizontally; the jumped-over peg is removed from the board. TRAP: Assuming jumps are horizontal-only leads to dead ends; vertical moves are essential for solving.

GOAL: Move three beads to form a triangle with a fixed centroid. CONTROLS: Click a bead, then click a destination spot to slide it there. RULE: The triangle’s center must align exactly with the target marker. TRAP: Assuming beads can pass through walls; paths must be clear or the move fails.

GOAL: Place both blocks inside the matching rings to clear the level. CONTROLS: Arrows shift the active block three spaces; clicking a block makes it active. RULE: Only the clicked block moves; others stay still until selected. TRAP: Assuming blocks slide until hitting a wall; they stop after exactly three spaces, even if not blocked.

GOAL: Route yellow and orange blocks into matching brackets on two separate rings. CONTROLS: Left arrows spin the left ring; right arrows spin the right ring. RULE: Each click advances a ring by one slot, shifting all blocks on it simultaneously. TRAP: Assuming a single shared path exists; you must rotate rings independently to align blocks without undoing progress.

GOAL: Match the main panel's pattern to its miniature reference image. CONTROLS: Click individual cells to toggle their color between red and white. RULE: The miniature acts as a strict template; the main grid must replicate it exactly. TRAP: Assuming symmetry or logical patterns exists; only the miniature's specific layout determines the solution.

GOAL: Paint the grid cells matching the white ring markers around each mini-icon. CONTROLS: Click a grid cell to toggle its color between blue and orange. RULE: The white cells in the mini-icon's outer ring dictate which grid cells must become orange.
